question: If I somehow visit Swinging Ship after the first combat phase of a turn has already ended, does it create an additional combat phase?

expected.shortAnswer: No: visiting it after the first combat phase has ended has no effect and no additional combat phase is created.
expected.answer: If you somehow visit Swinging Ship after the first combat phase of a turn has ended, it won’t have any effect. No additional combat phase will be created.
